create.name: Viviane Chauvet
create.bio:
Viviane Chauvet channels and teaches what she presents as Arcturian wisdom, calling herself an ambassador for the Arcturians, a star nation she says she works with directly. Her training spans several energy-healing and intuitive methods: certifications with the ThetaHealing Institute and the HeartMath Institute, in Dolores Cannon's QHHT and in the Unity Field Technique, along with study of Reiki and meditation. For more than fifteen years she has taught and spoken internationally, and she created two systems of her own, Arcturian Energy Matrix Healing and an Arcturian healing arts programme.

At the Arcturian University, the online school she founded, she gives a two-hour master class each month and leads group meditations and community gatherings, with a free library of meditations and introductory talks alongside. Her retreats take place at sacred sites in Sedona, Nepal, Germany and New Zealand among others, and she has taught on The Shift Network. She shares long guided meditations, such as the Rays of Creation series, without charge on YouTube, and her own story is told in the documentary An Arcturian Experience. She co-hosts the Infinite Star Connections podcast and has written chapters for several anthologies, The Way of the Initiate among them.

courses.title: Arcturian University Membership
courses.description: Monthly membership of Viviane's online school. The Cosmic tier includes the two-hour monthly master class, all master class replays and a starseed circle; the Universal tier adds further group sessions, community gatherings, the full replay library since 2021 and priority access to retreats.
courses.price: $77.00 USD every month (Cosmic) or $111.00 USD every month (Universal)

courses.title: Master Class – 12 Soul Aspects of Consciousness, Part 1
courses.description: A live two-hour online master class exploring the soul's twelve aspects of consciousness, from soul extensions to the soul matrix and soul family. The ticket includes a 60-day replay and is a one-time purchase, not a membership.

courses.title: The New Zealand Retreat 2027
courses.description: A week-long members' retreat at Lake Wānaka on New Zealand's South Island, with teaching sessions, a visit to Aoraki / Mount Cook, a stargazing evening and a boat journey on the lake. An optional onward journey across the South Island is offered separately.

courses.title: The Lion's Gate Retreat Replay
courses.description: Recordings of a five-day retreat livestreamed from the Blue Ridge Mountains in 2026, with teachings and guided transmissions on star alignments, solar language and the 'Library of Light'. Bought as a single replay ticket.

free_resources.title: Free Explorer Library
free_resources.description: A free membership tier giving access to Viviane's monthly guided meditations, interviews, the Infinite Star Connections podcast and the Arcturian Foundations question-and-answer series. A good place to start with her teaching.

sprint.tier_evidence: YouTube @VivianeChauvetGalacticHealer 29.5K subscribers (channel page, 31 Oct 2026); Instagram @viviane_chauvet and Facebook arcturianuniversity counts not readable without login → ~30k readable → local_hero
sprint.email_source: https://www.arcturianuniversity.com/Vivianechauvet-new-zealand-retreat-2027 (Cloudflare-protected address, decoded; given as the waitlist contact)
flags: The only published email (eline@arcturianuniversity.com) is a staff member's address given for the New Zealand retreat waitlist; her sites otherwise route everything through contact forms (support form: https://www.infinitehealingfromthestars.com/kopie-van-contact-pa; PA/professional: https://www.arcturianuniversity.com/contactPA1).
Instagram and Facebook follower counts could not be read without login; Facebook link is the Arcturian University page.
YouTube avatar is the Arcturian University logo, so not used; photos are her website portrait and the Shift Network headshot (same person, also matches the Awakened Magazine covers on her site).
She presents herself as an 'ascended Arcturian being in a holographic human hybrid form'; the bio frames her claims as her own description.

Much of her paid output (Arcturian Healing Chambers, 'Pathology of the Body' series on named organs and systems, Healing Chambers bundles) makes bodily-healing claims; all left out. The Universal membership tier includes the Healing Chambers sessions, though our description does not mention them.
Lion's Gate Retreat Replay is a recording of a past 2026 retreat, kept as an evergreen download; drop if a human prefers.
The New Zealand retreat page says it is members only.
left_out: Arcturian Healing Arts Program (https://www.infinitehealingfromthestars.com/arcturian-healing-course): her signature course, but promises body template restoration and quantum DNA repair and covers physical aspects; borderline, left out. No price published.
Arcturian Healing Chambers sessions and bundles (thyroid, endocrine, lymphatic, central nervous system, mitochondrial DNA, 'Pathology of the Body'): health claims.
Arcturian Wisdom (Shift Network course, https://theshiftnetwork.com/course/01VChauvet01_25): ran 9 December 2025 to 17 February 2026, registration closed; page also makes 'quantum medicine' claims.
Shift Network 'New Program With Viviane Chauvet' (begins April 2027): no title, URL or price yet.
Equinox Sedona Members Retreat (18-21 Sept 2026) and Wisdom Keepers Sedona (25-28 Sept 2026): already took place.
Master Class bundles ($175 for three): shared page with Healing Chambers bundles; single master class kept instead.

Books: she is one of many contributing authors in anthologies (The Way of the Initiate, Awakened Hearts, Wisdom of the Silver Sisters, The Light Within the Mind), not an author or co-author; none included.
Video 'Divine Presence and Cellular Upgrade - Meditation': 'cellular upgrade' read as a bodily claim, left out under the strict rule.
Short promos and trailers under 2 minutes (Gaia TV clip, 'A Gentle Invitation To Stay In Your Light') and the documentary trailer.
Private sessions: she no longer offers them.
Infinite Star Connections podcast: not a listed free-resource type; mentioned in the bio and inside the Free Explorer Library item.
